name: Street Custom 'Tooth Fairy' Pneumatic Bolt Pistol
description: A modified veterinary captive bolt pistol redesigned for use against humans. The original tool — used for livestock stunning — has been adapted with an extended barrel sleeve, a reinforced bolt, and a higher-pressure pneumatic cartridge that drives the bolt with enough force to penetrate the human skull at contact range. It is a point-blank assassination weapon, silent except for the pneumatic discharge, and leaves a wound that can be mistaken for a blunt force injury by inexperienced medical examiners. The weapon's association with slaughterhouse equipment gives it a particular psychological weight that its users exploit deliberately.
specifications:
bolt penetration: 7 cm hardened steel bolt
operating range: Contact only
power source: Single-use pneumatic cartridge
weight: 0.9 kg
reload: 4 seconds per cartridge swap
acoustic signature: 55 dB — comparable to a heavy book dropping
concealability: Fits inside a jacket pocket
story_hooks: A string of apparent blunt-force homicides in Tier 1 are revealed to be bolt pistol killings when a forensic specialist notices the consistent wound depth and diameter.
A slaughterhouse worker has gone missing along with two dozen pneumatic cartridges and the facility's entire stock of bolt pistol housings — someone is manufacturing Tooth Fairies at scale.

physical_description.visual_profile: A brutalist, industrial tool masquerading as veterinary equipment. Stocky and compact, with a pronounced forward-heavy weight distribution. The extended barrel sleeve dominates the silhouette, giving it a purposeful, surgical appearance despite its true function.
physical_description.dimensions: 22 cm length overall, 5 cm width at grip, 4.5 cm height at hammer assembly. Barrel sleeve extension adds 8 cm to original design.
physical_description.weight_description: Deceptively dense. Feels heavier in-hand than its 0.9 kg suggests due to internal pressure chambers and reinforced bolt assembly. Balanced toward the barrel for point-blank targeting precision.
physical_description.primary_material: Hardened steel frame with carbon-composite barrel sleeve jacket. Internal pneumatic valve assembly uses reinforced aluminum. Bolt is surgical-grade hardened steel.
physical_description.finish: Worn industrial gunmetal with micro-abrasions from field use. Steel surfaces show oxidation patterns consistent with slaughterhouse equipment. No cosmetic polish — purely functional patina.
physical_description.color_scheme: Muted gunmetal grey with charcoal composite accents on barrel sleeve. No branding colors intentionally applied — anonymity is aesthetic.
physical_description.grip_texture: Bare knurled steel with organic grip tape wrapped around trigger guard. Textured for wet conditions and gloved hands. Deliberately uncomfortable to discourage casual handling.
distinctive_features: Extended barrel sleeve with cooling vents suggesting industrial origin
Oversized pneumatic cartridge port at rear with wear marks from repeated swaps
Reinforced breech assembly with visible compression rings
Minimalist hammer mechanism — no safety visible
Micro-etched depth gauge on barrel indicating contact-range calibration
Custom-welded rail for bolt travel — rough welds deliberately left unground
Pressure relief valve venting system with faint rust bloom
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Original veterinary stamps partially filed but readable: 'KAUF-MANN LIVESTOCK SYSTEMS' faintly visible on frame. Street Custom modifications marked with cryptic serial scratch marks in cipher format — no conventional maker's mark.
physical_description.condition_typical: Field-worn and jury-maintained. Signs of careful degreasing and bolt replacement cycles. Internal mechanisms show evidence of pressure-testing. Finish is deliberately kept dull — reflective surfaces suggest careless ownership.
